name: Luna
source:
Zodiac: Cancer

MC is a small-town girl living alone. She doesn't have a clear, defined vision of her future yet and it's something she struggles with a lot. 

Likes: Coffee shops, video games, anime, romance stories and cute things. 
Dislikes: Homework, spiders, bills and the question "So, what are your future plans?"

Fun Fact: She has an affinity for the supernatural.

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/love-spell-written-in-the-stars]official website[/url]]
